A1.justification: Both complete 13-page PDFs describe the same pixel MeanFlow study. The main text, equations, tables, figures, references, and Appendices A–B are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Swiss-roll experiments, ImageNet generation results and ablations, and qualitative samples, including those in Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, quantitative results, ablations, and appendix samples.

M1.justification: Appendix Algorithm 2 changes the specified guided-training computation: the JVP direction changes from v_g to v_c, and the loss target becomes stopgrad(v_g). The helper also accepts and forwards w and c. These are localized procedural corrections; the core pMF formulation remains unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish changes to the implementation used for the reported experiments.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same projected Swiss-roll data and ImageNet generation scenarios at resolutions 64, 256, 512, and 1024. The appendix also retains the same class-conditional sample coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 6–7 retain the same baseline membership, including EPG-L/16 at 256 resolution and sCT-XXL and MeanFlow-RAE at 512. Prediction-target, optimizer, and preconditioner comparison sets are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Tables 6–7 revise reported model sizes, including pMF-B/16 from 119M to 118M parameters and pMF-B/32 from 123M to 120M. These change the stated model-size settings without establishing that experiments were rerun. Table 8's architectural configurations, training budgets, sampling settings, and the 50,000-sample evaluation protocol remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The prediction-target, optimizer, perceptual-loss, preconditioner, time-sampler, resolution, and scaling analyses are unchanged. Figures 1–3, Tables 2–5, and the appendix visualizations add no new analysis or robustness evidence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the experimental comparisons. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Resource values change: Table 6 revises B/16 from 119M/34 GFLOPs to 118M/33 and L/16 from 411M to 410M parameters. Table 7 revises B/32, L/32, and H/32 from 123M, 416M, and 962M to 120M, 413M, and 959M; L/32 also changes from 118 to 117 GFLOPs. All FID/IS scores and qualitative samples remain unchanged, including the headline FIDs of 2.22 and 2.48.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(12), the MeanFlow identity, the denoised-image-field definition, and the manifold boundary-case derivations are unchanged. Algorithm 2's computational corrections introduce no revised theoretical argument, assumption, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: one-step latent-free generation, separating prediction and loss spaces, and competitive ImageNet results. No central claim is added, removed, strengthened, or narrowed.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning manifold alignment, optimizer benefits, perceptual losses, restricted time sampling, and decoder overhead are unchanged. The qualification that intermediate denoised fields are not guaranteed to lie on the image manifold also remains unchanged.

D1.justification: Algorithm 2 fixes the mismatch between the helper's three-argument definition and its five-argument calls, and explicitly specifies conditioning, the JVP direction, and target detachment. This improves the implementation specification. Other Appendix A details, including hyperparameters, JAX/TPU usage, preprocessing, and guidance settings, are unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list and discussions in Sections 2 and 4.5 are unchanged. The positioning relative to iMF, JiT, consistency models, consistency trajectory models, and flow map matching remains the same.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp changes from v1, 29 January 2026, to v3, 9 May 2026. Apart from the technical edits assessed separately, prose, terminology, headings, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–8 retain their captions, structure, placement, and visual presentation. Algorithm 2 retains its layout. Numerical substitutions in the comparison tables do not constitute a display redesign.

improvement.justification: Algorithm 2 resolves an explicit function-argument mismatch and makes target detachment clear, providing a limited but concrete reproducibility improvement. Experimental evidence and conclusions are unchanged. The resource-count revisions remain unexplained, and Table 5 retains the earlier B/16 and L/16 counts, so those revisions do not establish improved efficiency or fully consistent reporting.
